phase: Each offset is nonzero, shares positive original-grid area, and lands on 576-input, 144-mask and 48-patch lattices.
polygon_admission: Same prior method, Shapely 2.0.2 / GEOS 3.11.2, valid noncrowd nonignored polygons strictly within both windows, continuous same-mother reciprocal IoU >=.95 and both second gaps >=.10. Edge margin from union of two admitted polygons.
freshness: Exclude all 36 original tested source prefixes from selection. No fallback or replacement.
selection: Select at most one near/far hull witness per fresh positive source, ordered by SHA-256 of salt + source tag + prefix. Within source, prefer near/far candidates that have a same-source, same absolute native crop-offset (dy,dx) both-interior control, then rank by SHA-256 of salt + row tag + sorted basenames and endpoint label IDs. Select one matched control by same rank per source when available. Near margin <=16, far margin >=64, both-interior margins >=64. Both witness types can share a crop pair and use different hulls.
pixel_verification: After the label-derived roster closes, decode and verify only its selected crop endpoints against native PNG and decoded RGB SHA. Check exact RGB in shared region. A failed pair remains failed with no replacement. Same-stratum control counts only if its source's selected near/far pair also passes.
scope: Geometry-enriched FIT feasibility only, no model forward or optimization, no DEV or TEST, original random 36-pair stop retained, no effect or method claim.
